jobs_results.title: Desarrollador Backend
jobs_results.location: Santiago de Compostela, Municipality of Santiago de Compostela, Spain
jobs_results.description:
Objetivo

Analizar, diseñar, desarrollar, desplegar y mantener sistemas y aplicaciones con alta disponibilidad que permitan la automatización de tareas y procesos de fabricación y el registro y análisis de la información generada mediante la toma de requisitos, diseño de la arquitectura e implementación del software, bajo la supervisión del Responsable de Ingeniería de Ajuste y Verificación, con el objetivo de lograr la optimización del proceso, eficiencia en los tiempos de ejecución y reducción de costes.

Funciones
• Realizar el análisis del alcance del proyecto, recopilar y especificar los requisitos del proyecto, diseñar y la arquitectura identificando los diferentes módulos y sus interacciones así como modelar la base de datos.
• Realizar la implementación de las funcionalidades identificadas haciendo uso del lenguaje de programación adecuado.
• Diseñar un plan de pruebas unitarias y de integración para su posterior ejecución y análisis

Perfil
• Grado en Ingeniería Informática ó... Telecomunicación. Valorable especialidad telemática y Máster en Ingeniería.
• Conocimientos en:
• Programación web (javascript, html5, css) ,
• Programación backend (python + flask, PhP),
• Interfaces de comunicación: ApiREST, Publica/Subscribe,
• Tecnologías de despliegue basadas en contenedores software (Docker)
• Diseño diagramas de arquitectura e interacción
• Control de versiones (git)
• Diseño de bases de datos (lenguaje SQL)

Se ofrece
• Incorporación inmediata y estable a una corporación multinacional gallega que sigue creciendo e invirtiendo en I+D más del 7% de sus beneficios.
• Formación continua y adaptada a las necesidades de cada trabajador
• Flexibilidad horaria que permite conciliar y gestionar tu tiempo.
• Modalidad híbrida con 2 días teletrabajo a la semana.
• Paquete de Retribución Flexible, Fisioterapia in house, Catering, y muchos otros beneficios

jobs_results.title: Desarrollador/a Backend en C# y Blazor- Remoto
jobs_results.description:
En Tarlogic buscamos desarrolladores Backend en C# para unirse a nuestro equipo de Research en remoto 100% porque... ¡el teletrabajo para nosotros es una realidad!

En este rol tendrás la oportunidad de trabajar con las últimas tecnologías de C#, ASP .Net Core, Blazor y con tecnologías Cloud de Azure. Formarás parte de un equipo multidisciplinar, dinámico y apasionado donde además usamos metodologías ágiles. Somos un equipo colaborativo y experimentado, donde todos contribuímos en la definición del producto, la forma de llevarlo a cabo y siempre buscamos mejorar. Este puesto requiere una combinación de habilidades técnicas sólidas y capacidad de colaboración en equipo para resolver problemas complejos y crear soluciones innovadoras.

¿Cuáles serán tus responsabilidades?
• Desarrollar aplicaciones web y soluciones en la nube con C# y Blazor.
• Participar en la planificación, diseño e implementación de soluciones de software.
• Trabajar en estrecha colaboración con equipos de desarrollo... de front-end y product managers para crear soluciones completas y escalables.
• Debugging y resolución de problemas en el código existente.
• Mantener y mejorar la calidad, rendimiento y escalabilidad de las aplicaciones
• Mantenerse actualizado con las últimas tecnologías de C# y Blazor y aplicarlas en el trabajo diario

¿Por qué unirte a Tarlogic?

En Tarlogic tenemos un gran equipo y queremos que formes parte de él.  Nuestros pilares son la comunicación, compromiso y trabajo en equipo. Participarás en proyectos pioneros con grandes clientes multinacionales a nivel global, en un sector puntero y en auge.

Además ofrecemos...
•   Trabajo 100% Remoto (pero puedes pasar por nuestras oficinas de Madrid o Santiago siempre que quieras )
•   Jornada intensiva los Viernes y todo el verano ( Sí..¡los 3 meses de verano!)
•   Flexibilidad horaria.
• Oportunidades de desarrollo profesional, plan de carrera individual y formaciones.
•   Posibilidad de elegir cuándo quieres disfrutar tus festivos.
• Ambiente de trabajo cercano y agradable
• y mucho más ¡No te lo pierdas! Requisitos: Requisitos:
• Experiencia profesional en desarrollo de software con C# . Mínimo, 1 año de experiencia.
•   Conocimiento de bases de datos relacionales y NoSQL
• Habilidad para trabajar de manera efectiva en equipo y comunicarse de manera clara y efectiva.
• Capacidad de aprendizaje rápido y resolución de problemas.    

Nos encantaría si además tuvieras:
• Conocimiento profundo de Blazor y el desarrollo de aplicaciones web
• Experiencia con el Cloud de Azure
•   Conocimiento de tecnologías web de Front: HTML, CSS y React

jobs_results.title: Backend Developer - Santander
jobs_results.description: Estamos reclutando un/a Backend Developer para reforzar nuestro equipo con la posibilidad de trabajar de forma remota. Lo que buscamos: Conocimientos de Java, HTML, CSS y JavaScript; Experiencia con Spring Boot, Spring Data, Spring Security; Conocimientos en bases de datos SQL y/o NoSQL; Experiencia en el diseño y consumo de APIs RESTful con conocimientos en OpenAPI3; Experiencia con frameworks de pruebas como JUnit y Mockito; Experiencia en testing (TBD, BDD, frameworks de testing, virtualización de servicios); Conocimientos básicos en CI/CD, Docker y Kubernetes; Experiencia y conocimiento en el diseño de patrones, arquitectura, pruebas automáticas y seguridad; Dominio del inglés; Experiencia con Scrum y Kanban (valorado). Lo que tenemos para ofrecer: Flexibilidad en el régimen de trabajo (remoto); Oportunidad de crecimiento profesional en una empresa en crecimiento; Ambiente de trabajo colaborativo y de apoyo; Paquete competitivo de beneficios. Si te identificas con este perfil... envíanos tu CV actualizado a ******. Si deseas obtener más información sobre nosotros: Movilges IT Consulting cuenta con más de 30 años de experiencia en el mercado español, especializada en Logística, Movilidad e IT. Ofrecemos servicios de consultoría, desarrollo de aplicaciones y mantenimiento de sistemas. Al igual que el universo tecnológico, en constante evolución, Movilges IT Consulting también busca evolucionar, aumentando su presencia en Portugal, brindando no solo los mejores servicios a socios y clientes, sino también ofreciendo las mejores condiciones, beneficios y oportunidades de crecimiento profesional para todo su equipo. En Portugal, estamos presentes en diferentes sectores, como tecnología, salud, administración pública, energía, servicios, banca y seguros. Al enviarnos tu solicitud, autorizas a Movilges IT Consulting a procesar tus datos personales, como nombre, correo electrónico, número de teléfono e información sobre tus experiencias académicas y profesionales, que figuran en tu CV. El procesamiento de estos datos solo tiene fines legítimos de la empresa, es decir, para los procesos de contratación de profesionales cualificados para nuestro equipo. Para cualquier pregunta relacionada con tus datos personales, puedes contactarnos en el correo electrónico ******. #J-18808-Ljbffr

jobs_results.title: Back End Developer (.Net)
jobs_results.description:
Enreach is a leading European provider of converged contact solutions for businesses. It provides intelligent communication technology and integrated modern telecom services that enable agile organization.

Enreach for Enterprises is a business unit of Enreach that targets corporations and enterprises based in Europe, offering modern, enterprise-level cloud-based telephony and communications solutions. The Enreach for Enterprises business unit has more than 100 colleagues in the Nordic countries.

In 2024, the objective is to expand Enreach for Enterprises organization and grow sales in key Enreach countries within Europe. This new development and growth phase brings new opportunities to the technology and R&D organization. We drive continuous product and technology innovations, including further development of global cloud-based microservices and modern cloud architectures.

Enreach for Enterprises product development team has developed a data analytics platform. We are now... modernizing and improving our product portfolio by developing the Voice Analytics platform further including replacing some of the existing components, expanding current capabilities and introducing AI. Therefore we are now strengthening our product development team with two new Backend Software Developers (.Net/C#).

More specifically, your tasks will include:
• Play a key role in developing exciting new features inside the Analytics application and integrating them into our core system.
• Work in close cooperation with a team of product developers, data analytics team, QA, architects and product managers
• Produce good quality code according to our DevOps and agile product development practices
• Produce technical documentation as required
• Contribute as third-line technical support for code-related customer issues

What you´ll bring:
• A minimum of 3-4 years working as a software developer in the backend
• Knowhow on modern backend software development (e.g. Python, .NET/C#, Java, Rust, Go)
• Knowhow on databases (e.g. MSQL, PostgreSQL, MariaDB)
• Experience in working with different messaging/data event systems (e.g. Rabbit MQ, Kafka)
• Experience in data analytics platforms is a plus (e.g. Snowflake, Power BI)
• Ability to work independently and in a multi-national team
• Good written and oral communication skills in English
• A proactive and cooperative team member
• Willingness to learn new technologies and tools and passion to produce high-quality code
• International mindset with respect for diversity

What makes us rock?
• For this position, we offer a permanent contract!
• Our flexible working hours make easier to get a life-work balance ⏰
• We can enjoy 23 days of vacation per year and 1 extra day to participate in any social responsibility activity
• Our bank holidays are flexible. You can enjoy them on the day they fall or exchange them for another day that suits you better 📅
• We have a "hybrid way of working" that allows us to combine working at home and coming to our Malaga office
• At Enreach we believe in personal growth, boosting different trainings and certifications, and offering language lessons (English and Spanish) at work!
• Flexible remuneration (public transport, healthcare insurance, restaurant ticket and kindergarten) is one of the perks that you can enjoy
• Sick leave coverage
• We love to create memorable experiences. We enjoy organizing social events to gather with colleagues a few times per year
• Join the ¨Juernes¨ every last Thursday of the month tasting some pizzas together
• We like to have fun, so in our office you can find a wide range of funny activities such as playing board games, ping pong, table football, video games, playing the guitar, eating fresh fruit, enjoying tasty coffee, or even drinking a beer with colleagues 🎯🎮
• We like to practice sports and outdoor activities together so you are welcome to join🚴

If all of this sounds interesting to you and you would like to be the new member of our family, do not hesitate to apply for the vacancy

jobs_results.title: Backend Developer
jobs_results.location: Las Palmas de Gran Canaria, Spain
jobs_results.description:
Backend Developer

Note: the position is on location. We work in a hybrid system (remote/office) but you must have your residence in Gran Canaria to work with us.

WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR:

We are looking for a Backend Developer to help us take our efforts to the next level and deliver new and exciting capabilities to our clients. Proactivity is a must but we are willing to invest in you, even if Golang is something new in your skillset.

HOW WILL BE YOUR TEAM

You will work with small cross-functional teams in a highly collaborative way, you will use the latest technologies, and enjoy seeing the direct impact of your work. You will have a thorough understanding of how a multichannel platform gets done from concept, to design, to a finished product.

WHAT IS THE CHALLENGE WAITING FOR YOU?

• Create full-scale applications, by working collaboratively and iteratively through design and development to deliver fully functioning web-based and mobile applications.

• Contribute to the... architecture across the technology stack, from database to native apps.

• Put emphasis on creating the foundation for rapid and effective implementation of systems.

• Deliver API / back-end code in Golang Golang (Google's High-Performance programming language)

• Create technical specifications and architecture documents, prepare and keep good documentation

• Perform basic support and debugging in test and production environment

• Maintain and repair existing applications.

KNOWLEDGE AND EXPERIENCE:

• 3+ years of development in one or more object-oriented languages, preferably GoLang, Java, C++, etc.

• Experience with containerization (e.g. Docker, Kubernetes) and modern architecture patterns (e.g. microservices and event-driven architectures)

• Experience with relational and non-relational data stores (e.g. MySQL/NDB, MongoDB, CouchDB, Cassandra, etc.)

• Significant experience writing and utilizing RESTful API services and performance-tuning large-scale applications

• Experience in analyzing data to draw business-relevant conclusions and in data visualization techniques and tools

• Experience with Agile development methodologies

• Excellent oral and written communication skills, including technical writing skills and the ability to effectively communicate with and engage cross-functional teams in various locations

• Proficient in English language written and spoken

QUALIFICATIONS

• Bachelor or higher degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent proven work experience in software development

COMPENSATION & BENEFITS

• Competitive salary: 35.000-45.000 € gross per year (based on knowledge and experience)

• Hybrid remote work

• Flexible working hours

• Reallocation package.

• Fully paid private health care packages for you and your kids

• Fully paid life insurance

• Gym membership provided by Beats

• Great location at the sunny Gran Canaria

• 1000 m2 Office with a fully stocked kitchen and an area facing wonderful views of Las Palmas de Gran Canaria’s seaside and Port.

• Standing desks

• 23 paid vacation days + official bank holidays in Spain.

Industry
• Information Technology & Services

Employment Type

Full-time

jobs_results.title: Remote Backend Developer (m/w/d) AWS CDK
jobs_results.description:
Our client from the pharmaceutical industry is looking for a (Lead) Backend Developer (m/f/n).

The purpose of the project is to focus on the further development of the client's Internet-of-Things applications using Amazon Web Services as the chosen environment.

IoT Application Incorporates user feedback, leading to further enhancements and improvements in the application delivery capabilities.

Projektbeschreibung
• Technical Consulting on the design and implementation of complex software solutions, based on contractors own experience and existing best practices and trends.
• Technical Consulting cross-functional teams to define, design, and ship new features. The Consultancy will be based on the contractor own technical background and expertise in software development.
• Techinical inspections of the existing system/architecture/code for performance, quality, and responsiveness of applications.
• Identify and correct bottlenecks and fix bugs using technical background
• Maintain... code quality, organization, and automatization in standard customers Tools.

The performance of the contractor has the goal to successfully implement Project Backlog and deliver quality code for application, upskill the team in development / Architecture.

Framework
• Start: mid of may 2024
• Duration: 6 months
• Capacity: 50% - 20 hours/week
• Remote: 100% - Near/offshore is advantageous in terms of price structure.
• Experience within the chemical/pharmaceutical industries is a great advantage

As the customer attaches great importance to technological experience, I would ask you to list the technologies you have already used on a project-specific rather than a general basis.

Skills
• Proven experience as a Lead Developer or similar role in software development.
• Proficient in AWS Cloud Services, CDK Toolkit, TypeScript NodeJS, and NestJS API framework.
• Solid understanding of software development life cycle models.
• Excellent problem-solving skills and attention to detail.
• Strong leadership skills with a dedication to driving and achieving results

IoT Application Incorporates user feedback, leading to further enhancements and improvements in the application delivery capabilities.

Projektbeschreibung
• Technical Consulting on the design and implementation of complex software solutions, based on contractors own experience and existing best practices and trends.
• Technical Consulting cross-functional teams to define, design, and ship new features. The Consultancy will be based on the contractor own technical background and expertise in software development.
• Techinical inspections of the existing system/architecture/code for performance, quality, and responsiveness of applications.
• Identify and correct bottlenecks and fix bugs using technical background
• Maintain... code quality, organization, and automatization in standard customers Tools.

The performance of the contractor has the goal to successfully implement Project Backlog and deliver quality code for application, upskill the team in development / Architecture.

Framework
• Start: mid of may 2024
• Duration: 6 months
• Capacity: 50% - 20 hours/week
• Remote: 100% - Near/offshore is advantageous in terms of price structure.

Skills
• Proven experience as a Lead Developer or similar role in software development.

• Strong leadership skills with a dedication to driving and achieving results

jobs_results.title: Backend Engineer
jobs_results.description:
(€35k-€40k per annum)

Our team in Spain is currently seeking a Backend Developer to join our dynamic team. We are looking for talented, self-motivated individuals with strong expertise in AWS and a passion for data.

Who We Are?

First let us introduce ourselves, we are FERO and are a VC backed startup building a brand new solution that improves the customer experience when completing checkout and payment journey driving an increase in conversion and increased revenue for our clients.

The Role & Your Responsibilities
• Technical Excellence: FERO values innovation and quality, and as a Back End Engineer, your role is at the heart of our mission, focusing on high-performance, scalable, and testable code within our architecture.
• Design and Develop: Collaborate with an exceptional team to craft scalable products, focusing on performance, scalability, quality, and testability. You will be at the forefront of innovation, engaging in our RESTful API initiatives, and preparing for... exciting future developments.
• Performance and Scalability: Utilise cutting-edge technologies to boost system performance and tackle scalability challenges.
• Quality and Testability: Uphold the integrity of our codebase through comprehensive test-driven development and continuous integration frameworks.
• Innovation: Stay at the leading edge of technology, with a readiness for potential explorations like SDK development and language migration.

What You Must Bring?
• At least 3 years of experience as a Backend Developer, with hands-on expertise in AWS services and infrastructure.
• Strong proficiency with Python. Experience with Django is a big plus.
• Familiarity with both relational and non-relational databases such as PostgreSQL and DynamoDB.
• Extensive experience designing and working with REST APIs.
• A DevOps mentality, with a willingness to bridge development and operations.
• Working Permit in Spain

Desirable Traits
• Curiosity, resilience, positivity and a passion for continuous learning and growth.
• Resourcefulness, inquisitiveness, and a supportive attitude towards colleagues.
• Team collaboration, exemplary communication skills, and a drive to solve complex problems.
• Start up mentality

Why Work at FERO?

As an early-stage, VC-backed startup, FERO provides competitive pay combined with employee equity (we are all owners!). We have an exquisite/central office for our Tech hub in Madrid and have a very creative and collaborative culture. We offer:
• Unique greenfield environment to drive change in a global business. What we are doing is brand new which offers exciting challenges to overcome
• Joining at this stage in our journey will open up opportunities for exponential growth in professional and personal development
• Friendly and supportive colleagues
• Hybrid working model: 3 Days office/2 Days WFH
• Competitive compensation package and private health insurance that is half sponsored by FERO

Where to From Here?

Obviously, this has to be mutually beneficial: we want you to step into a role you love and we want to offer you a place you’re proud to come to every day. First steps are for you to forward an english CV to this advert

jobs_results.title: Senior Back End Developer
jobs_results.description:
Our customer provides the premier internet gaming platform. Over its two-decade existence, this platform has emerged as the top contender in the online gaming sector worldwide.

As a Senior Backend Developer, you will be part of the Software Engineering department, which is responsible for developing and delivering enterprise-level software solutions. You will be forming part of our talented team of developers, actively engaging in the creation of innovative features to enhance the product and maintaining existing functionality.

Requirements:
• Advanced proficiency in utilizing the latest .NET Technologies (.NET Core, WebAPIs, Orleans) within the B2B software industry, particularly in the dynamic environment of igaming solutions
• Extensive experience working with microservices architecture, showcasing the ability to design and implement scalable solutions for the igaming space
• Hands-on experience with event-driven microservices architecture, ideally using Kafka and Microsoft... Orleans' actor framework, leveraging different communication ports including REST, Events and RPC
• Adept at planning and executing tasks both autonomously and collaboratively within a team, emphasising effective communication and collaboration
• Deep knowledge of source control and GIT Flow, emphasising best practices for version control
• Experience with JIRA is considered helpful, with a preference for familiarity with tools that enhance collaboration and project management
• Strong expertise in multithreading and concurrency, with practical experience optimizing software for performance and reliability
• Proven experience in debugging, performance profiling, and optimization, showcasing a commitment to delivering high-quality software solutions
• Solid understanding of observability principles and tools, such as Prometheus and Grafana
• Considerable experience with client/server or N-tier architectures, complemented by a comprehensive understanding of object-oriented and service-oriented application development.
• Strong understanding of the software development cycle, emphasising the ability to navigate and contribute effectively throughout the entire development process
• Exceptional development, time management, and problem-solving skills, aligning with the demands of the fast-paced igaming industry.

Responsibilities:
• Leverage an in-depth understanding of software engineering principles and best practices to contribute to the development and enhancement of our products.
• Collaborate closely with cross-functional teams to analyse requirements and translate them into efficient and scalable software solutions, taking into consideration performance, security, and integration aspects.
• Demonstrate technical leadership by actively participating in the design and development of complex system features, providing guidance to junior team members, and ensuring the adherence to coding standards.
• Drive the implementation of best practices in coding, testing, and deployment to maintain a high standard of code quality and support scalable and maintainable software solutions.
• Stay abreast of industry trends, emerging technologies, and advancements in software engineering, actively incorporating relevant insights into the development process to enhance our software offerings

jobs_results.title: Desarrolladores/as Backend/Front end/ fullstack (He/She/They)
jobs_results.description:
¡Estamos ampliando nuestro equipo #TEC y #SP- Sector Público en Mallorca !

¿Tienes experiencia en el desarrollo de plataformas digitales modernas? Sí tu respuesta es que sí, ¡únete a nuestro equipo! Y si no lo tienes claro... no pierdas la oportunidad de intentarlo, y ¡envíanos tu CV!

El objetivo es participar en nuevos proyectos de desarrollo y transformación digital con tecnologías nuevas en el front y en el back utilizando principalmente como stack tecnológico Spring Boot, Kubernetes… aplicando metodologías Agile, cultura DevOps y orientación hacia la automatizació

¿Cuáles serían tus funciones?

· Definir soluciones equilibradas y seguras (demanda/viabilidad).

· Diseñar e implementar técnicamente programas, módulos o modelos.

· Construir, probar y documentar elementos estructurales de la solución.

· Diseñar planes de pruebas, pruebas unitarias y de integración.

· Proporcionar soporte al equipo en su ámbito de expertise.

· Desarrollar conocimiento y capacidades necesarios en... su ámbito y que le permitan autoorganizarse y colaborar en equipo.

· Estimar esfuerzos, controlar avance, alcance, planificación y priorización.

Requisitos valorables:

· Experiencia de 3 años o superior en el diseño técnico y desarrollo de software, ejecución de pruebas, documentación de proyecto.

Formato de trabajo:

En NTT Data apostamos por un modelo de trabajo flexible con posibilidades de trabajar tanto presencialmente en nuestras nuevas oficinas en Barcelona así como con las opciones de full remote y en un formato híbrido.

Tenemos un modelo de carreras personalizado con revisión salarial semestral, apuesta clara por la formación continua (técnica, metodológica y competencial), acceso a certificaciones, diferentes modalidades de trabajo (incluyendo el teletrabajo), conciliación laboral (flexibilidad horaria y jornada intensiva los viernes y los meses de verano) y beneficios sociales (seguro de vida, mutua de salud y ayuda flexible que te permitirán destinar tu retribución flexible a aquello que necesites).

También podrás formar parte de "The Blue Wave", el equipo de voluntariado de la compañía que participa en iniciativas de acción social y medioambiental apoyando a los colectivos que más lo necesitan. En NTT DATA avanzamos todos a la vez, por una misma causa y con una energía única. Eso es The Blue Wave, el Portal de Voluntariado (The Blue Wave (nttdatavolunteering.com).

#Together, Grow as One #One heart, one NTT DATA. Future at Heart

¿Quieres conocernos?

NTT DATA somos todas las personas que la formamos. Un equipo de más de 139.000 profesionales, tan diverso cómo diversos son los 50 países en los que estamos presentes.

¿Nuestra misión? Ofrecer soluciones tecnológicas, de negocio, estrategia, desarrollo y mantenimiento de aplicaciones, siendo un referente en consultoría. Todo gracias a la colaboración entre equipos, la calidad humana de nuestra gente y a que no nos conformamos con lo establecido, buscamos siempre la innovación que nos acerca al futuro. Nuestro talento nos ha hecho poder decir con orgullo que somos una de las 6 empresas TOP de tecnologías en el mundo.

En NTT DATA creemos que toda persona es única y diferente y por ello apostamos por una cultura inclusiva que reconoce y valora la diversidad. Trabajamos día a día para crear un entorno en el que podamos explorar, vivir y potenciar nuestra propia singularidad.

#WeAreAS #Front #WeAreAllUnique #YouMakeUsUnique #TheDigitalLovers
